scope: HIP native-fallback RMSNorm only; inference BF16 input/weight, widths 128/2048, ranks 2/3, at most 512 rows, eps 1e-6; no residual/post/quantization, cast override, variance override, padding, batch invariance or Gemma semantics
fallback: unsupported semantics retain original dispatch; stale source/runtime/model/device requires omission of the module override and environment
rollback: omit WORKSTATION_RMSNORM_NO_RESIDUAL and the dedicated layernorm module mount; start a fresh mounted-GEMM incumbent process
cache_reuse: fresh owner boot/runtime/source/model/device identity; private bounded cache per startup
